questions.question: Which radioactive isotope has a half - life of 5770 years, which is commonly used to estimate the age of organic materials such as paper and parchment?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**14C.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carbon-14 (14C):-**

 
 
• It is the radioactive isotope with a half-life of 5770 years that is commonly used to estimate the age of organic materials such as paper and parchment.
 
• This is because when plants and animals are alive, they take in carbon-14 from the atmosphere.
 
• Once they die, the carbon-14 starts to decay at a known rate, allowing scientists to determine how long ago the organism died.
 
• Carbon-14 dating is a widely used method in archaeology, paleontology, and other fields to determine the age of artifacts and fossils.

questions.question: Which of the following is the right relationship between geometric length (Lg) and magnetic length (Lₘ)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lm = (5/6) * Lg.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Geometric length (Lg):-**

 
 
• **It refers to the physical length of a conductor, while magnetic length (Lm) takes into account the end effects caused by the magnetic field around the conductor.**
 
• End effects refer to the distortion of the magnetic field near the ends of a conductor, which causes the effective length of the conductor to be shorter than its physical length.
 
• The correct relationship between Lg and Lm is important in the design and analysis of electrical machines and devices such as transformers and motors.
 
• This relationship is derived from the fact that the magnetic length is shorter than the geometric length due to the presence of end effects.
 
• **The relationship between geometric length (Lg) and magnetic length (Lm) is Lm = (5)/(6) * Lg.**

questions.question: Which of these statements is true?

options.text: At lower rates of interest, people will have a lower preference for liquidity.
At higher rates of interest transactions demand for money will be higher.
At lower rates of interest, speculative demand for money will be higher.
At higher rates of interest liquidity preference of people will increase

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**At lower rates of interest, speculative demand for money will be higher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Speculative demand for money:-**

 
 
• It refers to the demand for money to be held as an asset for future profitable investment opportunities.
 
• At lower rates of interest, the opportunity cost of holding money is lower, making it more attractive to invest in speculative assets.
 
• At higher rates of interest, the opportunity cost of holding money is higher, making it less attractive to invest in speculative assets. 
 
• Therefore, speculative demand for money will be higher at lower rates of interest.

• **British Empire Games:-**

 
 
• **These were started in 1930 and were held every four years until 1950.**
 
• The games were designed to bring together athletes from the British Empire and promote goodwill and understanding among them.
 
• The first games were held in Hamilton, Canada, and featured 400 athletes from 11 countries competing in six sports.
 
• The games were renamed the Commonwealth Games in 1978 and have since been held every four years, with the exception of 2020 when they were cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**lengthiest written constitution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Constitution:-**

 
 
• It was adopted on 26th January 1950 and has undergone several amendments since then. It currently consists of a Preamble, 448 Articles, and 12 Schedules.
 
• **The Constitution is considered the lengthiest written constitution in the world because of its comprehensive nature and detailed provisions covering various aspects of governance, rights, and duties of citizens, and the functioning of the government.**
 
• The Constitution is also unique in its approach to federalism, where there is a division of powers between the central government and the state governments. This has been achieved through the distribution of powers in the Union List, State List, and Concurrent List.
 
• The Constitution also provides for a system of checks and balances, where the three branches of government (legislature, executive, and judiciary) have separate and distinct functions, and each branch acts as a check on the other two.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Constitution is not a rigid constitution.:-**

 
 
• The Indian Constitution is a mix of both rigid and flexible features. While some provisions of the Constitution can only be amended by a special majority of the Parliament, other provisions can be amended by a simple majority. 
 
 
 
• **Indian Constitution provides for a presidential form of government:-**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution provides for a parliamentary form of government where the President is a nominal head of state, and the Prime Minister is the real head of the government.
 
 
 
• **Indian Constitution provides for dual citizenship:-**
 
 
• The Indian Constitution does not provide for dual citizenship. Instead, it recognizes a single citizenship for all Indian citizens.
